moon.role: Full-Stack Mobile Developer and Automation Engineer
moon.summary: Led end-to-end delivery across a portfolio of AI-driven mobile applications, from MVP architecture and interface work to testing, monetization, and release.

bullets.one: Built LifeOS, MusicAI, and Text RPG through database design, custom UI, and automated testing.
bullets.two: Implemented RevenueCat subscriptions and secure in-app purchases across the product portfolio.
bullets.three: Integrated Lyria, Gemini Vision, Veo, LLM APIs, Cloud Functions, and FFmpeg pipelines.
bullets.four: Used Cursor, Claude Code, and Agent Hermes to accelerate UI work, refactoring, and delivery.

bengkel.role: Full-Stack Mobile Developer and Automation Engineer
bengkel.summary: Owned deployment cycles, live releases, cross-team delivery, and production systems for mobile applications used by real customers.

bullets.one: Managed App Store Connect and Google Play releases for Suluk and Travelogi.
bullets.two: Built CI/CD distribution flows with Codemagic and TestFlight.
bullets.three: Developed a PPOB platform with payment integrations and an HR attendance system.
bullets.four: Created an n8n content pipeline that reduced manual publishing work by more than 15 hours weekly.

langgeng.summary: Developed mobile IoT applications for home automation and smart watering systems, connecting device constraints with reliable software experiences.

bullets.one: Built Smart Card Saga and Smart Watering for real-time monitoring and analysis.
bullets.two: Integrated RabbitMQ for asynchronous communication and resilient system behavior.
bullets.three: Implemented SQLite for reliable offline mobile-IoT functionality.
bullets.four: Worked across hardware and software teams to move prototypes toward production.
